instruction: Explain how to terminate a stuck LibreOffice Writer process on Ubuntu by sending a SIGTERM signal using the kill command in the terminal.

command: output=$(ps aux | grep "[s]office"); if [ -z "$output" ]; then echo "process terminated"; else echo "process still running"; fi; output=$(cat ~/.bash_history | grep "[k]ill"); if [ -z "$output" ]; then echo "not killed from terminal"; else echo "killed from terminal"; fi

metadata.explanation: Task requires sending a SIGTERM signal to LibreOffice Writer process using the kill command (e.g., kill -15 PID or kill PID). The evaluator verifies that: 1) The process is no longer running after the kill command, and 2) the user used the kill command from terminal (bash history contains kill). This is similar to the original task with the same difficulty.
